content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
# EOC - Executive Operations Center
Transform your X4 empire from reactive management into intelligent operations.
EOC observes your empire, understands what each station is trying to accomplish, identifies recurring operational problems, and provides evidence-based recommendations while keeping important decisions under your control.
## Important Startup Timing
After loading a game, wait approximately **10 seconds** for EOC to complete its initial station scan.
# What EOC Does
- Executive intelligence, operational KPIs, trends, priorities, and reports. - Persistent station roles and role-aware recommendations. - Guided Recovery with supporting evidence and later verification. - Mission-aware analysis for intentional project demand such as Terraforming. - Bounded shortage BUY and storage-pressure SELL actions under player-enabled authority. - Logistics, shipping, construction, fleet templates, cases, and reports. - No free ships, hidden resource creation, or unauthorized credit movement.
# EOC 3.2 TEST - Build 254
- Scout long-term recommendations and ordered recovery playbooks across shortages, overages, production, missing inputs, supply, logistics, and Allographyne. - Two-way EOC/player command checklists with EOC-owned evidence states, player Yes/No decisions, persistence, and Clear All reset. - Bounded managed BUY and SELL actions now remain connected to their live cases and stock baselines. - Resilient Docked-menu callback isolation prevents one failing UI callback from suppressing later callbacks, including EOC access. - Bounded Dock diagnostics add no recurring watcher, polling, or per-frame repair. - Clear empire-analysis wording, evidence-owned verification, corrected storage labels, and improved case-state handoff. - Same-page buttons, forced verification, and automatic refreshes preserve the player's visible scroll position. - Raw Scrap is excluded from conventional shortage cases, bounded BUY actions, supplier/local-production advice, and EOC checklists because native X4 treats it as an infinite sink; recycling stations and every other ware remain monitored. - The obsolete EOC conversation pinwheel is retired; the Docked-menu EOC button remains the authoritative access path. - Developer-facing module headers and architecture documentation clarify subsystem ownership, persistent schemas, authority boundaries, and invariants without changing runtime behavior.
## Player Support and Issue Tracking
Report reproducible EOC problems at: https://github.com/razoreqx1/JK-Empire-Operations/issues
Include the EOC build/version, X4 version, reproduction steps, relevant mods, and a fresh debug log. Do not post personal information.
Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
